answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using decentralized latency profiling. Auditor nodes use quartz oscillators to timestamp challenge packets, requiring candidates to immediately mirror the payloads. Applying ridge regression to the resulting latency vectors reveals co-located clusters, forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable cost of leasing distinct physical network hardware per identity. However, this mechanism penalizes honest agents operating behind high-latency connections.
